about: A memory benchmark in the style of LongMemEval, at small scale. Each case is a short chat. After Equal has read it, the benchmark checks which facts were kept, whether their dates are right, whether small talk was left out, and whether questions are answered from memory or correctly declined. Days are relative to the day the benchmark runs: 0 is today, 1 is tomorrow, -2 is two days ago.
